title: Align synthetic Case bootstrap with canonical HTTP Case picker selector validation
goal: Ensure the operator-local Case viewer never chooses or advertises an owner Case selector that the first-party authenticated Case Timeline/picker refuses; reject malformed in-scope Case catalog before minting bearer or listener.
invariants: Reuse the exact existing HTTP Case selector predicate including valid UTF-8, byte-length, forbidden control characters, and nonblank semantics; never trim or normalize opaque valid IDs.
For an in-scope owner candidate with an invalid selector, abort synthetic viewer bootstrap before minting a bearer/listener, as the first-party Case picker denies the entire malformed catalog.
Keep first-party server Case/Timeline/source authorization unchanged; never infer access from CLI flags or an operator-provided source payload.
Do not modify any L2-frozen parent HEAD, canonical product contract, OPEN decision or production IAM.
security_properties: Do not announce an unusable, malformed or different Case ID, especially before first-party Case permissions are evaluated.
Refuse an in-scope malformed Case ID even if the analyst is not a reader, because the first-party discovery enumerates the whole in-scope catalog before applying read ACL.
Cross-tenant/out-of-environment case candidates do not authorize another tenant and cannot be selected.

migration.rationale: Read-only synthetic startup and shared selector predicate compatibility only

rollback.strategy: Revert child integration PR after review; audited parent unchanged
verification: Existing correct whitespace-distinct opaque selectors remain unchanged

inputs: Existing CAP-INV-110 Case/Timeline read-only HTTP picker and viewer
First-party validHTTPCaseSelector in case_http.go (server), distinct from CLI firstDemoAuthorizedCase selection in snapshot.go
E10-INV-110F-SELECTOR and E10-INV-110G-EXACT are recorded IMPLEMENTED (not ACCEPTED), whereas E10-INV-110E is VERIFIED.
outputs: Single canonical exported selector predicate reused by first-party HTTP picker and operator-local startup, no duplicate frontend approximation
Synthetic local viewer denies malformed in-scope candidate before credential/listener, and selects valid space-distinct owner ID exactly
Exact-HEAD Go/Node Linux, macOS, Windows plus unchanged security mandatory floor and review handoff
acceptance_tests: Bad in-scope catalog ID with NUL, CR, LF, invalid UTF-8, blank or >1024 bytes: no selected Case and no synthetic bearer/listener, including unreadable same-tenant candidate
Valid authorized opaque ID with surrounding whitespace remains byte-for-byte unchanged and selectable
Out-of-scope Case cannot replace authorized Case; first-party HTTP picker/Timeline predicates unchanged
All exact SHA GitHub required workflows observed, no waiver of 90% security-critical changed code coverage

performance_budget.rationale: Bounded in-memory Case catalog selection and pure string selector reuse

definition_of_ready: Canonical CAP-INV-110 read-only Case selection and CAP-INV-101 consumer are in scope, no Case mutation or OPEN-013 claim
Single root mismatch between firstDemoAuthorizedCase and server selector, no new permission authority

Existing E10-INV-110G-EXACT is IMPLEMENTED (not VERIFIED) and is a permitted integration dependency; E10-INV-110E separately remains VERIFIED. This new child stays IMPLEMENTED pending mandatory checks and approvals.
definition_of_done: One deterministic Case startup and first-party HTTP selector consistency test
